hook.text: You buy an iPhone, then AirPods, then an Apple Watch. Switching to Android means losing them all.

buildup.text: Platform lock-in makes users invest in an ecosystem so switching costs become too high.

discovery.text: iMessage's blue bubble vs green bubble creates social pressure to stay on iPhone.

twist.text: Google counters with free services — Gmail, Drive, Photos — that work on any device.

climax.text: Lock-in is the ultimate retention strategy: make leaving harder than staying.

punchline.text: The best retention is making switching painful.

quiz.question: How does platform lock-in retain users?
options: By making switching costs higher than staying
